collection.title: Nissan Cabstar 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Nissan Cabstar 2012 Onwards model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
